verdict.rationale: Conductor's core design gives each task its own isolated workspace/branch/files/diff/terminal, enabling multiple parallel agent attempts (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode) with a review path to compare outcomes before merging, and this is corroborated by hands-on community use (worktree-based isolation, parallel agent runs). missing for 10: no explicit side-by-side comparison UI documented (only per-task diff/review), and some community friction around GitHub permissions rather than the comparison feature itself.
